events.verdict: Paul (HOU) initially establishes legal position in O'Neale's (UTA) path but makes some marginal contact after the initial contact during the pick.
Rubio (UTA) engages with Paul (HOU) on the perimeter but does not affect his FOM.
Paul (HOU) slightly extends a forearm into O'Neale (UTA) during the pick but does not affect his ability to defend.
Capela (HOU) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Gobert (UTA) maintians legal position during the pick with Gordon (HOU).
Capela (HOU) makes contact with Gobert's (UTA) wrist and pulls his hand off of the ball during his put back attempt.
Tucker (HOU) maintains legal position during Crowder's (UTA) pass following the rebound.
Harden (HOU) takes more than two steps after his gather.
Rubio (UTA) makes contact with Harden's (HOU) arm during his shooting motion on his jump shot.
Gobert (UTA) is firming up in legal position during the pick with Gordon (HOU).
Gordon (HOU) is moving forward into Mitchell's (UTA) body and makes contact with his arm during his jump shot.
Harden (HOU) slightly extends an arm into Rubio (UTA) during his drive but does not affect his ability to defend.
Rubio (UTA) steps towards Harden (HOU) to contest his shot attempt and makes marginal foot to foot contact after he lands.
Crowder (UTA) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Mitchell (UTA) cleanly steals the ball from Harden (HOU).
LAR shows - Following the steal, Mitchell (UTA) steps out of bounds while in possession of the ball.
